site_name: 164-196 TRUNDLEY'S ROAD AND 1-9 SANFORD STREET, LONDON, SE8 5JE
description: Application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) for a non-material amendment to planning permission DC/20/117966 dated 5 November 2021 in order to allow for an increase of 9no. student rooms, taking the total from 393 to 402 rooms proposed; amalgamate the smaller clusters to create 9-bed clusters in direct response to the preference of universities; increase in the number of studio units to increase the choice of accommodation and a reduction in the size of Cluster A from 8-bed to 7-bed; increase in the shared amenity space at ground, basement and first floor levels; and increase of 7no. additional long-stay cycle parking spaces at basement leve at 164-196 Trundleys Road and 1-9 Sanford Street, SE8.ÿ
